notes.title: Get Ready to Groove: The Rhythm Towers Demo is on Steam!
notes.content:
We're ecstatic to announce that a demo of Rhythm Towers, the funkiest fusion of rhythm action and tower defense, is now available!


Set on the vibrant Planet Rhapsody, Rhythm Towers challenges you to protect the AlgoRhythm - a mystical power source that keeps the planet alive and groovy. But watch out, Creeps are on the rampage, driven by a supernatural force that despises music. It's up to you, members of a once-failed alien pop group with the power of rhythm, to save the day!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1703240/Rhythm_Towers_Demo/


Gameplay: Where Rhythm Meets Strategy
In Rhythm Towers, every beat counts! Build and upgrade towers that double as musical instruments and are powered by your rhythm matching skills, each adding layers to the dynamic soundtrack. Sync your defenses with the music to unleash powerful attacks and keep the Creeps at bay. The demo includes:

- A comprehensive tutorial to get you in the groove.
- A hip-hop level to get your head bopping.
- An intense drum n bass level to ramp up the challenge.


[url=https://discord.gg/8YDxytt]Join our Discord community[/url]  - share your thoughts on the demo, and let's make some noise together! Your feedback will be instrumental in making Rhythm Towers the best it can be.


Stay Tuned!
Keep an eye out for more updates and exciting news. There will be a future update to the demo that will include a co-op mode, allowing you to jam and defend with a friend!


Stay funky, stay strategic, and see you on Rhapsody!
